Émotions est une production Louie Media,: Émotions is a Louie Media production, one of the most respected podcast studios in France. The podcast explores human emotions through intimate stories, expert interviews and careful narration.
Un podcast immersif et intimiste sur les: An immersive, intimate podcast about human emotions — jealousy, anger, disappointment, fear. Well written and moving, it sparks genuine introspection in a few dozen minutes. The careful narration recalls the great popular psychology books, in audio form. Our verdict: intense and memorable, but best taken in small doses — listening to several episodes in a row can be emotionally draining. Prepare your emotions… and your sense of humour!
